title_en: Provisions of the State Council on the Handling of Foreign-Related Intellectual Property Disputes

articles.content_en: Article 5 The intellectual property administrative department and the competent commerce department of the State Council shall, in accordance with their respective functions and duties, strengthen tracking and understanding of key information such as changes in foreign intellectual property legal systems, conduct analysis and research on typical cases, promptly issue risk warnings, and provide the public with early warnings on foreign-related intellectual property.

Article 6 The intellectual property administrative department and the competent commerce department of the State Council shall, in accordance with their respective functions and duties, improve the institutions and working procedures for guiding the handling of foreign-related intellectual property disputes, and provide response guidance and rights protection assistance to citizens and organizations in handling foreign-related intellectual property disputes.

Article 7 Commercial mediation organizations and arbitration institutions shall be supported to participate in the resolution of foreign-related intellectual property disputes, providing citizens and organizations with efficient and convenient means for resolving foreign-related intellectual property disputes, and encouraging and guiding citizens and organizations to quickly resolve foreign-related intellectual property disputes through settlement, mediation, arbitration, and other means.
The judicial administrative department of the State Council shall strengthen guidance on the mediation and arbitration of foreign-related intellectual property disputes.

Article 8 Law firms, intellectual property service institutions, and others shall be encouraged to enhance their capacity for foreign-related intellectual property services, establish practice institutions abroad through setting up branches, joint operations, or other means, and provide citizens and organizations with high-quality and efficient foreign-related intellectual property-related services.
The judicial administrative department of the State Council and the intellectual property administrative department, in conjunction with relevant departments, shall take measures to create conditions for law firms, intellectual property service institutions, and others to strengthen foreign-related intellectual property-related services.

Article 9 Enterprises shall be supported in establishing mutual assistance funds for foreign-related intellectual property protection and rights protection, and insurance institutions shall be encouraged to conduct foreign-related intellectual property-related insurance business in accordance with market principles, so as to reduce the costs of rights protection for enterprises.

Article 10 Chambers of commerce, industry associations, cross-border e-commerce platforms, and other organizations shall be encouraged to set up platforms for rights protection assistance in foreign-related intellectual property, open service hotlines, and provide public interest services such as consultation and training.

Article 11 Enterprises shall enhance their awareness of the rule of law, establish and improve internal rules and regulations, strengthen the reserve of intellectual property talents, and reinforce intellectual property protection and utilization; when entering foreign markets, they shall actively understand the legal systems and intellectual property protection status of the country or region where they are located, conduct production and business operations in accordance with law, and actively safeguard their legitimate rights and interests.
The intellectual property administrative department and the competent commerce department of the State Council, in conjunction with relevant departments, shall focus on the intellectual property protection needs of enterprises in their foreign-related production and business activities, carry out publicity and training for enterprises centering on key areas and critical links of foreign-related intellectual property disputes, and introduce experiences and practices of handling foreign-related intellectual property disputes in accordance with law in combination with typical cases, so as to enhance enterprises' awareness of foreign-related intellectual property protection and their capacity to handle disputes.
The judicial administrative department of the State Council shall, in accordance with the requirements of the responsibility system for popularizing law whereby "the law enforcement agency is also responsible for popularizing the law," strengthen publicity and education on the rule of law related to intellectual property, and comprehensively enhance the awareness of intellectual property protection and the ability to protect rights in accordance with law of citizens and organizations.

Article 12 Service of documents and investigation and evidence collection within the territory of China shall be handled in accordance with the international treaties concluded or acceded to by China and the provisions of laws such as the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the International Criminal Judicial Assistance Law of the People's Republic of China. No organization or individual shall, in violation of the provisions of Chinese laws, serve documents or conduct investigation and evidence collection within the territory of China.

Article 13 Where organizations or individuals within the territory of China participate in foreign-related intellectual property litigation or are subject to relevant investigations by foreign judicial or law enforcement agencies, and need to provide evidence or relevant materials abroad, they shall comply with the provisions of laws and administrative regulations on the protection of state secrets, data security, personal information protection, technology export management, judicial assistance, and the like. Where approval from the competent authority is required according to law, the relevant legal procedures shall be fulfilled.

Article 14 The competent commerce department of the State Council may, in accordance with the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China, investigate the following matters and take necessary measures:
(1) imported goods infringe intellectual property rights and harm the order of foreign trade;
(2) the holder of an intellectual property right commits any of the following acts and harms the fair competition order of foreign trade: preventing the licensee from challenging the validity of the intellectual property right in the license contract, engaging in compulsory package licensing, or stipulating exclusive grant-back conditions in the license contract; or
(3) other countries or regions fail to grant national treatment to Chinese citizens and organizations in intellectual property protection, or fail to provide sufficient and effective intellectual property protection for goods, technologies, or services originating from China.

Article 15 Where a foreign State, in violation of international law and the basic norms of international relations, uses intellectual property disputes as a pretext to contain or suppress China, adopts discriminatory restrictive measures against Chinese citizens or organizations, or interferes in China's internal affairs, the relevant departments of the State Council may, in accordance with the Foreign Relations Law of the People's Republic of China, the Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law of the People's Republic of China, and other laws, include organizations or individuals that directly or indirectly participate in formulating, deciding, or implementing the discriminatory restrictive measures in a countermeasure list and take corresponding countermeasures and restrictive measures.

Article 16 No organization or individual shall execute or assist in executing the discriminatory restrictive measures adopted by a foreign State against Chinese citizens or organizations under the pretext of intellectual property disputes.
Any organization or individual that violates the provisions of the preceding paragraph and infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of Chinese citizens or organizations may be sued by such citizens or organizations before the People's Court according to law, demanding cessation of the infringement and compensation for losses.

Article 17 The relevant departments of the State Council shall strengthen coordination and cooperation. For those who use intellectual property disputes to harm China's sovereignty, security, or development interests, corresponding measures shall be taken in accordance with the National Security Law of the People's Republic of China, the Foreign Relations Law of the People's Republic of China, the Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law of the People's Republic of China, and other laws. For acts of abusing intellectual property rights to eliminate or restrict competition or engaging in unfair competition, the matter shall be handled in accordance with the Anti-Monopoly Law of the People's Republic of China, the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, and other laws.
Article 18 These Provisions shall come into force as of May 1, 2025.
